''''Red Eagle'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall.  It rotates into Famous Painter Lupini's stock on Winter 15 during the [[Night Market]] starting in year 1, and reappears on Winter 15 every 3 years.  It can be purchased for {{Price|1200}}.

==Trivia==
'Red Eagle' is in the art style of the Native American tribe [[wikipedia:Hopi|Hopi]].
